# Kiran Growth School

> Kiran Growth School is a performance marketing agency in India for solar companies and real estate businesses. Services: Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram), Google Ads, website design, AI video production, AI avatar videos and AI automation (WhatsApp bots, CRM and follow-up). Serves Delhi, Delhi NCR (Gurugram, Ghaziabad, Noida, Faridabad) and Madhya Pradesh (Bhopal, Rewa, Satna). Founded by Sitanshu Tripathi. All enquiries: WhatsApp +91 93998 51765 (https://wa.me/919399851765).

Key facts:
- Primary business: performance marketing agency (lead generation for solar installers/EPCs, real estate builders, brokers and channel partners).
- Secondary: an academy with two courses, Meta Ads & Digital Marketing (₹25,000) and AI Tools & Website Design (₹25,000).

## Industries
- [Solar marketing agency](https://kirangrowthschool.online/solar-marketing-agency/): rooftop solar and PM Surya Ghar subsidy lead generation for installers and EPCs.
- [Real estate marketing agency](https://kirangrowthschool.online/real-estate-marketing-agency/): RERA-compliant property lead generation for builders, brokers and channel partners.

## Services
- [Meta Ads](https://kirangrowthschool.online/services/meta-ads/): Facebook and Instagram ad campaigns that bring qualified solar and real estate leads in Delhi NCR, Gurugram, Ghaziabad, Bhopal, Rewa and Satna. Lead forms, WhatsApp ads, CAPI tracking.
- [Google Ads](https://kirangrowthschool.online/services/google-ads/): Google Search, Performance Max and YouTube campaigns for rooftop solar and real estate. Capture high-intent searches like 'solar panel installation near me' and '3 BHK in Gurugram'.
- [Website Design](https://kirangrowthschool.online/services/website-design/): Fast, mobile-first websites and landing pages for solar companies, builders and brokers. Built for SEO, Google Ads Quality Score and WhatsApp enquiries.
- [AI Videos](https://kirangrowthschool.online/services/ai-video-production/): AI-assisted video ads, reels, explainers and property walkthroughs for solar and real estate brands. Fast turnaround without a studio shoot.
- [AI Avatar Videos](https://kirangrowthschool.online/services/ai-avatar-videos/): AI avatar spokesperson videos for solar companies, builders and brokers. Explain subsidy, projects and offers in Hindi or English without recording every time.
- [AI Automation](https://kirangrowthschool.online/services/ai-automation/): AI automation for solar and real estate sales teams: instant WhatsApp replies, lead routing, CRM updates, follow-up sequences and site-visit reminders.

## Blog
- [PM Surya Ghar 2026: How Solar Installers Can Turn the Subsidy into Steady Leads](https://kirangrowthschool.online/blog/pm-surya-ghar-solar-leads-guide-for-installers/): A practical guide for rooftop solar installers and EPCs on using PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana in ads, landing pages and WhatsApp follow-up to get qualified residential leads.
- [Meta Ads for Solar Companies in India: The Campaign Setup That Brings Real Site Surveys](https://kirangrowthschool.online/blog/meta-ads-for-solar-companies-india/): How to structure Facebook and Instagram ads for rooftop solar: objectives, lead forms vs WhatsApp, creatives, targeting and tracking that bring qualified solar leads.
- [Google Ads for Solar Installers: Keywords, Negatives and Campaign Structure for 2026](https://kirangrowthschool.online/blog/google-ads-for-solar-installers-keywords/): A ready-to-use Google Ads plan for rooftop solar companies in India, with keyword groups, negative keywords, ad copy ideas, call tracking and landing page tips.
- [Real Estate Lead Generation in Gurugram: A Playbook for Builders and Channel Partners](https://kirangrowthschool.online/blog/real-estate-lead-generation-gurugram-dwarka-expressway/): How builders, brokers and channel partners in Gurugram can generate exclusive property leads with Meta Ads, Google Ads, project microsites and fast WhatsApp follow-up.
- [RERA-Compliant Real Estate Ads: What Builders and Brokers Must Show on Meta, Google and Websites](https://kirangrowthschool.online/blog/rera-compliant-real-estate-ads-meta-google/): A plain-language checklist for RERA-compliant property advertising in Delhi NCR and Madhya Pradesh, covering registration numbers, claims, landing pages and channel partner ads.
- [Digital Marketing for Solar and Real Estate in Bhopal, Rewa and Satna](https://kirangrowthschool.online/blog/digital-marketing-solar-real-estate-bhopal-rewa-satna/): How solar installers and property developers in Madhya Pradesh can use Hindi-first Meta Ads, Google Search, WhatsApp and local proof to win customers in Bhopal, Rewa and Satna.
- [AI Avatar Videos for Real Estate and Solar: Use Cases, Workflow and Mistakes to Avoid](https://kirangrowthschool.online/blog/ai-avatar-videos-for-real-estate-and-solar/): How builders, brokers and solar companies can use AI avatar and AI-generated videos for ads, explainers and WhatsApp follow-up, with a simple production workflow.
- [WhatsApp and AI Automation for Lead Follow-up: A Setup Guide for Solar and Real Estate Teams](https://kirangrowthschool.online/blog/whatsapp-ai-automation-lead-follow-up/): How to connect Meta, Google and website leads to WhatsApp and a simple CRM so every enquiry gets an instant reply, gets routed to the right salesperson and is followed up on time.
- [The High-Converting Website Checklist for Solar and Real Estate Businesses (SEO + AI Search Ready)](https://kirangrowthschool.online/blog/high-converting-website-solar-real-estate/): A 25-point checklist for solar company and real estate websites: speed, WhatsApp CTAs, local SEO pages, schema markup and content that Google, ChatGPT and Claude can understand and cite.
- [How to Choose a Performance Marketing Agency in Delhi NCR for Your Solar or Real Estate Business](https://kirangrowthschool.online/blog/how-to-choose-performance-marketing-agency-delhi-ncr/): Twelve questions to ask before hiring a performance marketing agency in Delhi, Gurugram, Ghaziabad or Noida, plus red flags, pricing models and what a good first month looks like.
